name: 2 Wild 2 Die

features.name: Silver and Gold Revolvers
features.description: Fire one to six bullets that create wilds and wild multipliers.

features.name: Repeat hits
features.description: A second hit adds a multiplier to an existing wild.

features.name: Best of Bonus
features.description: Plays two bonus rounds and lets you take the better result.

review:
A 5x4 western shootout built around revolvers. Silver and gold revolvers land with one to six bullets and fire them at random spots – a first silver hit turns a spot wild, repeat hits turn it into a wild multiplier, and gold bullets go straight to multipliers.

Every revolver fires whether it wins or not, so the base game always has action. Two bonus rounds, plus Hacksaw's Best of Bonus, which shows you both outcomes before you pick. 15,000x max, and a great-looking dusty saloon.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
